messages:
maya_k: Quick heads-up — final on-site for Infra Eng candidate tomorrow 2:00pm PT. 3 interviewers, 45m total (design + troubleshooting). Need: scribe, debrief owner, and recording consent. Can someone take scribe? @eli_t?
eli_t: I can scribe, +1 for taking debrief notes. pls drop eval form link. :thumbsup:
maya_k: amazing, thanks. eval form: https://rwd.io/evals/infra-final (uses short anchors). Also please confirm candidate recording consent at start.
recruiter_bot: Reminder scheduled — please submit scores within 24h after debrief. Auto-reminder 1h before event.
samir_p: Quick rubric q: for final, should we prioritize system design tradeoffs or runtime/inference ops knowledge? I'm leaning 60% runtime, 40% design.
maya_k: Yup — weight runtime + debugging higher. Candidate will have short KV-cache optimization prompt; emphasize approach and tradeoffs.
nina: I'll join as backup interviewer in case of conflict.
eli_t: Copy. Will run this quick checklist at start and capture timestamped notes.

```
Pre-interview checklist (for scribe):
- Confirm recording consent verbally and note timestamp
- Open eval form, pre-fill candidate name + slot
- Note major takeaways per anchor (runtime, debugging, design)
- Tag recommended follow-up questions in comments
- Capture final recommendation: hire / no-hire / grey-zone
```

people_ops: FYI — added debrief template to calendar event and set 30m buffer after for scoring. Link in event notes.
eli_t: Will post scribe notes to the debrief doc right after call and ping the panel for quick 10m async alignment.
maya_k: Perfect — if anything changes ping here. otherwise: see y'all tomorrow 2pm PT. :rocket:
